symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of a participating axis, one of the $D$ axes.
symbols.quote: Let $D$ be the number of participating axes, and let $i$ index them (the letter changes meaning here).

symbols.name: current axis length
symbols.meaning: The current recursive length of axis $i$: the number of entries that axis holds at the level the round processes.
symbols.quote: Let $\ell_i$ be the current recursive length of axis $i$, the entries it holds at the level processed.

symbols.name: branch bit
symbols.meaning: The bit the round writes on axis $i$, recording which output of the butterfly an entry is.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta_i\in\{0,1\}$ be the branch bit the round writes on axis $i$.

symbols.name: twiddle index
symbols.meaning: The index of the twiddle on axis $i$, an integer with $0\le\nu_i<\ell_i/2$.
symbols.quote: Let $\nu_i$ be the index of the twiddle on axis $i$, with $0\le\nu_i<\ell_i/2$.

symbols.name: twiddle exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of the twiddle at an address, an integer taken modulo $2r$.
symbols.quote: The letter $\eta$ changes meaning here: it is the twiddle exponent at each address, an integer taken modulo $2r$, given by

symbols.name: quotient of exponent
symbols.meaning: The integer quotient of $\eta$ by $r$, which counts the whole multiples of $r$ in $\eta$.
symbols.quote: Write $\eta=er+\delta$ with $0\le\delta<r$, where $e$ is the integer quotient of $\eta$ by $r$, the number of whole multiples of $r$ in $\eta$ (the letter $e$ changes meaning here), and $\delta$ is the remainder.

symbols.name: remainder of exponent
symbols.meaning: The remainder of $\eta$ on division by $r$, with $0\le\delta<r$.
symbols.quote: Write $\eta=er+\delta$ with $0\le\delta<r$, where $e$ is the integer quotient of $\eta$ by $r$, the number of whole multiples of $r$ in $\eta$ (the letter $e$ changes meaning here), and $\delta$ is the remainder.

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The butterfly applied on every participating axis at once.
symbols.quote: The parallel butterfly $\mathcal{H}$ applies $H_0$ on every participating axis.

symbols.name: monomial operation
symbols.meaning: The operation multiplying each record at an address by $y^\eta$.
symbols.quote: The monomial operation $\mathcal{J}_\eta$ multiplies each record by $y^\eta$ at its address.

relations.quote: A transform round is one stage of the [multidimensional transform](multidimensional-transform.md): every participating axis takes one butterfly step at once, then the twiddles are applied.
A transform round computes its butterfly by the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md), which applies $\mathcal{H}$ in one pass.
